title: Servitization of business: Adding value by adding services
method_and_data: Conceptual paper with company examples [M]
key_findings: [M] Introduces 'servitization': firms move from goods to market packages of goods, services, support, knowledge and self-service, with the service component dominating the bundle. Customers' search for value and for outsourcing of non-core tasks drives it.
key_quote_with_page: n/a (full text not read; no page quote verified)

notes: Foundational citation for the servitization lens. Content from memory; read before quoting. AI agents extend it: the 'service' is now performed by software, so the pattern is closer to 'service as software'.

authors: Baines, T. S., Lightfoot, H. W., Benedettini, O., & Kay, J. M.

notes: Manufacturing context; transfer to SaaS needs argument. Pair with Fang et al. (2008) and Gebauer-type paradox findings (not included).
